name: Tianzhao Mandate
summary: An ancient bureaucratic civilization whose politics and culture are shaped by harmony, long-term consequence, celestial order and a practical, administrative approach to the spirits it believes in.
gateAttitude: Tianzhao first interpreted the Gates through its existing concepts of the Spirit and Celestial realms.
beliefs: Tianzhao's religious life is its own: overlapping traditions of Heaven, ancestor veneration, local gods, divine officials, spirits, death courts, reincarnation, household rites and a celestial bureaucracy. Its folklore tells of **Collectors**, or Officers of Passage, who guide the dead; of spirit officials, dragons, fox spirits, talismans and true names; and of old stories of passages into other realms.
visualSummary: Lacquer, porcelain, paper seals, cinnabar, jade and precise machinery, integrated into very old architectural traditions.

relations.text: A polite rivalry over ports, access and influence; tea is leverage.
An old trading partner that accepts Tianzhao's restrictions while the trade stays worthwhile.
Mutual respect for craft; disagreement over metaphysical caution.
Admires its science, not its constant agitation; older officials still say 'Solenne'.
Strong scholarly respect; Verna wants Tianzhao's archives, and access is granted sparingly.

sponsorFraming: Access to Tianzhao physicians, medicines, therapeutic traditions and spiritual care through your sponsor.
extraRule: Once between expeditions, when you make progress on a Recovery Project for one of your own Consequences, gain +1 additional Progress.
